cls: Setting these to 0 seems risky. A negative timestamp, say -1000us, means the next frame would be -677us. Both of these being 0 will probably cause issues. A negative number its fine imo, just WebRTC…
DCHECKs are enabled in certain canary builds accessible to the general population. I think you risk getting crash reports this way.
Extra {} is now unneeded. It was only there to ensure that the first lock is released before the second one is grabbed.
